name: Swarm Scatter [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You have studied the habits of swarming rats for defensive tactics.

Benefit(s): Each ally adjacent to you gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. This bonus stacks with itself for each adjacent ally granting this bonus. As long as you are granting this bonus, you and your allies affected by it are immune to the swarm attack and distraction ability of rat swarms.
